QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] The Unsaved
QuestInfo.0: Von Leon guards the lonely castle all by himself. Go have a chat with him.
QuestInfo.1: Von Leon refuses to listen to reason. Perhaps action will change his mind.
QuestInfo.2: Von Leon remains a broken man, scarred forever by an unkind fate and a deal with the Black Mage. He is distraught over the loss of his beloved Ifia's. All he has to remember her by is a pair of his earrings, that he bequeaths to you.
